title: desire
about: From the start: the engine's boot logo, skipped with Enter, then the maze before any other input (the player at the start cell, facing along the corridor). The window's title says the scene: 'BootLogo | Enter: Skip / Esc: Quit', then 'Maze | WASD: Move / Arrows : Look / F2: Retry / Esc: Quit | Enemy: FIND ...'. Under Wine with a software renderer the logo lasts a few seconds; the first wait takes the shot inside it. `random`: the seeds of the Wine run its screenshots were taken from (out/oracle/desire/start1), so that the maze is that run's.
